title: Data Pad - Destinations
textLines: A quiet chime interrupts your thoughts.
The door hums faintly behind you, its seals dimming as power flickers.
The data pad buzzes again, its display flickering.
TRANSPORT SYSTEM WILL DEACTIVATE IN ERROR 99:99.
You glance at the schematic one last time. Whatever you do, you have to do it now, before the power's gone for good.
